name: EPIC 202691551
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 2, 11.6 solar radii and 0.80 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 202691551 (K2 campaign 2): PARAM radius (solar radii) 11.615342 (16th-84th percentiles 11.381136-11.975593), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

text.card: A red giant 3,289 parsecs away, 12 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 2, give 0.80 solar masses and 11.6 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,638 K at its surface.
